newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae dissident group has 23 mln votes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae dissident group has 23 mln votes.

text.p: A dissident group of the Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday after a special shareholder meeting that it has received 23 million votes of some 53 million shares outstanding in favor of an alternative reorganization plan.
"I feel like an incredible winner," said Albert Lord, a current director of the government sponsored enterprise and a leader of the dissident group.
The group said it will continue a tally on the vote until May 29.
